$description: Proposed support policy over existing feature checks and fallbacks. Owner reviews release support targets.

features.fallback: Use the packaged CommonJS build in a compatible application build tool.
Present a linear list using the same semantic reading order.
Platform overlay components retain their existing focus and modal behavior.
Existing positioned overlay fallback; keep dismiss and focus-return behavior.
The application must provide an Intl polyfill before mounting.

testing: Run the repository changed-page, keyboard and accessibility suites in Chrome.
Validate Safari, Firefox and Edge manually before declaring a release supported.
A supported query does not claim these browsers have all been tested.
